ruleDefinitions.name: Renamed Remote Utilities RAT (RURAT) Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of renamed Remote Utilities (RURAT) via Product PE header field

sequences.query: process_product = "Remote\ Utilities" AND  NOT ((process_path = RGX("\\\\rutserv\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\rfusclient\\\.exe$")))
